critical_code_review_comments: Non-critical: framer-motion useScroll emits a console warning 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' from Hero.jsx. The hero section already has class 'relative overflow-hidden' so position is set, but the warning still appears â€” likely benign but E1 could investigate the ref target.

Consider pausing auto-cycle on hover for accessibility (onMouseEnter sets active but does not pause the interval, so highlight can jump while a user hovers).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport must be 1920x950 (or any >=1024 lg) to render hero floating chips. Chips use -top-8/-translate-y-full and -bottom-8/translate-y-full so they sit outside the voice-demo card. Auto-cycle intervals: Manifesto=2200ms, SocialProof=2000ms. Highlighted card is identifiable by className containing 'bg-swara-maroon'. Move mouse to (10,10) before sampling to avoid onMouseEnter setActive interfering.
rca of the issue: Previously chips were absolutely positioned inside the voice-demo container without translate-Y offsets, causing them to overlap the chat conversation. Fix moves chips fully outside the card: top chip anchored at -top-8 with -translate-y-full (its full height above the card), bottom chip at -bottom-8 with translate-y-full (its full height below). Verified via bounding-box overlap check between each chip and the 'Welcome to Spice Garden!' greeting bubble â€” no rectangle overlap.
